facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document of 22 December 2023 states that UNICEF is supporting the Government of Lesotho on a pilot programme for the digitisation of select civil registration processes; it gives no count of offices and does not say where the pilot runs.
facts.system: UNICEF-supported pilot program for the digitization of select civil registration processes

facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document of 22 December 2023 states that the digitisation of select civil registration processes is a pilot supported by UNICEF, and that the proposed US$12 million IDA credit (Component 3, US$5 million; approval expected 23 January 2024, closing 31 March 2028) will finance technical assistance for the digitalisation of selected Department of Home Affairs services, namely civil registration, identification and authentication; no domestic budget line is stated.
